review_policy: Evidence is reviewed at candidate build time; every record carries finding_date and expiry. External-release eligibility requires affirmative, independently-sourced re-approval that is fresh, tool-exact, and non-repository-authored (D-24).

openclaude.status_reason: Upstream LICENSE disclaims authorization to distribute Anthropic's underlying proprietary source; the project states it does not hold Anthropic's authorization to redistribute their proprietary code.

cursor-agent.status_reason: Cursor Terms of Service grant a personal use license but prohibit reproducing or copying the Service; no redistribution grant for the agent distribution was identified.

antigravity.status_reason: Google's general software terms are personal/non-assignable and prohibit copying or distribution; Antigravity's additional terms incorporate those terms, so redistribution is not affirmatively granted.

claude-code.status_reason: Current official redistribution status could not be affirmatively established from research; the natural binary uses a signed release manifest and the npm wrapper's license field is not a redistribution grant.

copilot.status_reason: Copilot CLI redistribution is conditionally permitted only when the package remains unmodified and is distributed as part of an application; conditions must be preserved or external release fails closed.

codex.status_reason: Apache-2.0 licensed; redistribution permitted with notice/attribution obligations preserved (Apache/MIT notices mandatory).

opencode.status_reason: MIT-licensed; redistribution permitted with attribution notice preserved.

herdr.status_reason: Open-source license with attribution/notice obligations preserved; redistribution grant identified.

pi-agent.status_reason: MIT-licensed; redistribution permitted with attribution notice preserved.
